title: Lexus USA pressroom: 2026 Lexus ES launches with battery-electric models
notes: ES 350e/500e share one 74.7 kWh pack; 11 kW onboard AC; 10-80% about 28 min, up to 150 kW; NACS J3400 port, CCS adapter included; Battery Preconditioning from the touchscreen or automatically with a public charger as destination (Drive Connect trial or subscription).
